summary: Net Power Inc. reported via Form 8-K that its indirect subsidiary, Net Power, LLC, acquired EMPower USA, LLC's position as owner under an EPC agreement for a 123-MW natural-gas reciprocating-engine facility, plus related rights and warranties. The transaction closed on August 31, 2026. Consideration included a $40.0 million premium (of which $20.0 million was pre-funded as deposits), reimbursement of $18,947,272.70 in prior EPC payments, and assumption of commitments, totaling $58,947,272.70 in cash. The acquired EPC agreement was dated December 15, 2025, with Saulsbury Industries and equipment supply from Wärtsilä. Watch for project execution and cost overruns.
